name: s_lighthouse
prompt: Two versions of the SAME small seaside lighthouse side by side, each standing on its own little rocky base, for a cozy pixel art island game. Straight-on FRONT VIEW exactly like Stardew Valley buildings (not isometric, not rotated, facade facing the viewer), both the same size and pixel scale, generous white space between them. LEFT: the lighthouse ruined after a storm - the glass lantern room at the top is shattered and dark, the red and white stripes faded and peeling, cracks in the stone tower, the little wooden door boarded up with planks, ivy and moss creeping up, a few fallen stones at the base. RIGHT: the SAME lighthouse fully restored - fresh bright red and white stripes, a clean glass lantern room with a warm glowing yellow light inside, a little balcony railing, a green wooden door with a round window, a flower box. The towers are tall and narrow, about three times taller than wide. No other objects, no text

name: s_market

No people, no text, no letters

name: s_ferry
prompt: A single cozy passenger ferry boat for a pixel art island game, drawn in the same style, outline and pixel scale as the reference boat but about twice as long: pure SIDE VIEW facing left, white hull with a red stripe and a navy bottom, a small two deck cabin with round portholes and a little wheelhouse, a short red chimney, a string of colorful flags from the mast to the bow, life rings on the railing, sitting on the water line. Only the boat, no water, no text
